solver.kind: blind AI solver B (separate agent, answer-free packet, adversarial rubric)

S048-01.notes: 'Although meticulously documented' + her own letters contradict inevitability -> conclusion not justified = unwarranted. 'Exhaustive' echoes 'meticulously documented' (trap); 'derivative' and 'understated' lack support.

S048-02.notes: Fleas from a midge-free lake still grew spines as readily -> ability persisted. A contradicts the result; B unsupported; D reverses the stated cost (spines slow reproduction) and is not about the experiment. Factual basis (Daphnia/Chaoborus inducible neckteeth/spines with reproductive cost) is accurate.

S048-03.notes: Only A uses the unplanted control staying flat to rule out citywide weather. B lacks the control; C is a single-year cross-section that ignores the baseline (planted streets were warmer in 2018); D is baseline only.

S048-04.notes: Two independent clauses; 'however' sits mid-second-clause. A = comma splice, B = run-on. C (colon) was considered: the second clause contradicts rather than explains/elaborates on the first, and a colon before a 'however' clause is nonstandard, so D is the single best answer.

S048-05.notes: Particles replace the rejected solid-sheet model -> 'Instead.' Nonetheless implies a contrast with the instability proof (wrong); Similarly/For instance do not fit. Facts check: Maxwell's Adams Prize essay (1856-59) showed solid rings would be unstable and break up; 'torn apart by Saturn's gravity' is an acceptable simplification. 'Two centuries' from 1610/1655 to the 1850s is fine.

S048-06.notes: Only C gives the mechanism (yearly weather-driven ring widths) AND the comparison (one winter vs. 150-year range). A and D give the result without why or the comparison; B covers radiocarbon only. Dendrochronology facts are accurate (felling season can be determined when the bark edge survives).

S048-07.notes: Praise limited by heavy criticism = qualified. 'Effusive' is the opposite; 'anonymous' and 'premature' have no support.

S048-08.notes: Suppression is equal with fungi killed -> the effect does not need fungi. B is contradicted by the design; C is about harm to tomatoes (no data); D cannot be inferred (no sterilized pots without marigolds). Minor note, not a flag: the setup does not say whether the no-marigold comparison pots were sterilized, but that does not affect the key.

S048-09.notes: The claim compares benefit across groups -> need the user-minus-nonuser difference for both groups (8 vs 4). A uses a raw gain without control; B gives only the at-grade group; C shows a benefit in both groups but not which is larger.

S048-10.notes: Vint holds TV viewing constant and finds differences tied to city work -> TV is unlikely to be the cause. A contradicts 'not broadcast speech'; C disputes a fact she never questions; D is unsupported.

S048-11.notes: The drawer of 'letters she did not intend to answer' signals she will not follow through on the order. B is contradicted (she wrote the title down); A and D are unsupported. One possible gloss is that pride keeps her from admitting she does not know the book; it still points to C.

S048-12.notes: Believing lenses could not be fixed, he therefore turned to a mirror -> cause and effect = 'Accordingly.' 'Nevertheless' is the trap (wrongly read as contrast with 'wrongly'). Facts check: Newton believed chromatic aberration could not be removed and built a reflector in 1668; achromatic lenses came later (Hall/Dollond).
